parallels.note: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

translations.web: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
translations.bsb: I thought that after she had done all these things, she would return to Me. But she did not return, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.
